source.title: Claude hunt 2026-10-20 (angle: pullbacks in the day trend): Matteo Conti's drift VWAP pullback, both sides in one day instance (the close on the trend side of a 09:30 VWAP that is sloping that way over 15 minutes, price moved 0.1 %+ that way over the last hour, then the first candle against it = the pullback, market at the next open), with the hunt's exits: 40-point stop, 60-point target on both sides (1:1.5) in place of the video's 80 / 40-50. Why it should pay: when price holds above a rising session VWAP and is up on the hour, the day's buyers are in profit and the first red candle is the dip they buy; 1:1.5 asks the trend for a new push, not a 0.5R bounce. Who loses: counter-trend traders who short the first red candle of an up day (buy the first green candle of a down day).

entry.words: Long when the trend is true -- the 5-minute close above the VWAP anchored at the 09:30 open, the VWAP higher than 15 minutes ago, and the price up at least 0.1 % over the last hour -- and a red candle (the first one, the pullback) comes: buy at the next bar's open by market order. Short is the mirror. Entries 10:30-15:30 ET, one position at a time, at most 4 trades a day over both sides, stop for the day after 2 losing trades in a row. Stop 40 points, target 60 points on both sides.
